references.context: Hit Sparky to qualify and score Electric Chair Multiball.
references.label: Sparky and Electric Chair
references.description: Build Electric Chair progress and collect its jackpots here.

references.context: Lower the inline drops, then hit Grave Marker.
references.label: Grave Marker
references.description: Qualify its Multiball and collect its special jackpots here.

references.context: Shoot the Snake lane for the timed Pick award.
references.label: Snake lane
references.description: Collect the Pick add-a-ball and timed 2x during Multiball.

references.context: Complete the four Pick targets before Multiball.
references.label: Pick targets
references.description: Complete all four to light the timed Snake award.

references.label: FUEL targets
references.description: Complete these to light the piston target for 2x playfield scoring.

references.context: Hit the piston target to start FUEL 2x.
references.label: Piston target
references.description: Start the timed FUEL playfield multiplier here.

references.context: Move the Spider to a safe major shot and collect items there.
references.label: Spider arrows
references.description: The last major shot can collect lit Chair, Snake, and Grave Marker items.

references.context: Hit or graze the Coffin captive ball for Coffin items and Multiball.
references.label: Coffin captive ball
references.description: Collect Coffins and qualify the stackable Coffin Multiball.

references.context: Shoot the right scoop to choose Crank It Up.
references.label: Right scoop
references.description: Start a qualified Crank It Up mode or collect its cash-out.

references.context: Use the right ramp for METALLICA and Lady Justice progress.
references.label: Right ramp
references.description: Advance METALLICA and alternate Lady Justice shots here.
